label: Quotient Blog (document view)
description: The Quotient blog document view, matched to the real app: left nav (Blog active), breadcrumb top bar with search + New Chat, doc header row (Last updated, campaign chip, Threads, Draft/Published status pill), hero image, title + dek, Authors/Slug/Tags/Publish Date meta rows, word count, and body prose. The 'publish-blog' script action flips the header pill from Draft to the green rocket Published state -- the blog's money beat. Also scroll-doc and highlight-hero. Use for 'the blog ships' payoffs and any beat set on a Quotient blog post.

campaign.label: Campaign chip + breadcrumb segment (e.g. 'Weekly Blog Post')

published_when.label: Text after 'Published' on the pill (e.g. 'just now')

word_count.label: Word count shown above the body

script.label: Timed actions: publish-blog {at, published_when?}, highlight-hero {at}, scroll-doc {at, amount, duration}. Cursor targets: 'status', 'hero'.
